subject: Invoice cadence proposal, tranche remits, and VAT evidence for annual prepay
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@procurecorp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@ledgerops.co
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Annual prepay — request for staggered invoicing & VAT evidence

Hi Olga,

Thanks again — ProcureCorp is ready to move forward with the annual prepay commitment (DEAL-7421). Procurement asked me to confirm the invoicing approach so our treasury team can schedule wiring across Q1. A few asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood invoice in three scheduled tranches aligned to product milestones (Dec, Mar, Jun)? We prefer split invoices tied to the attached PO.
- We need VAT-compliant invoices for the EU entity (address on PO) plus machine-readable VAT evidence for audit.
- Please include your bank wiring instructions (SWIFT/IBAN) and a sample invoice for our AP team to verify.

I've attached the signed PO (ProcureCorp_PO_7421.pdf). Please confirm timeline by EOD Tuesday so I can loop in Treasury.

Best,
Maria Santos
Head of Procurement — ProcureCorp
Attachments: ProcureCorp_PO_7421.pdf
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@procurecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — request for staggered invoicing & VAT evidence

Hi Maria — thanks for the signed PO and clear asks. Proposing the following staggered invoicing plan to match your milestones and to simplify your treasury windows: 

1) Invoice 1 (Dec 15): 40% of annual commitment — triggers access to Dedicated pool and onboarding milestone.
2) Invoice 2 (Mar 15): 30% — post-initial usage review and measurement window.
3) Invoice 3 (Jun 15): 30% — final tranche and activation of committed autoscaling.

We will produce EU VAT invoices for each tranche (company name and VAT ID per PO). For audit evidence, we can provide: VAT-register certificates (PDF), machine-readable metadata in the invoice XML, and a short attestation letter. I attached a draft schedule (Redwood_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx) and a zip of the VAT certs we commonly provide (VAT_Certificates_EU.zip).

Bank details (for outward wire):
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
- Bank: Evergreen Bank, IBAN: GB33EVRG00000000000000, SWIFT: EVRGGB2L
- Remit reference: DEAL-7421 / ProcureCorp PO 7421

Next steps: 
- Ben, can you confirm if we can accept the requested Dec 15 invoice date operationally?
- Kimberly / Rachel, please confirm invoice template includes the machine-readable VAT block (schema v2) and that AP sample matches ProcureCorp requirements.

Maria — if that schedule works, we will send the DocuSign link for the SOW addendum and lock the invoice dates in our billing system.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Director, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Schedule_v1.xlsx; VAT_Certificates_EU.zip
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Maria Santos <maria.santos@procurecorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T14:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — request for staggered invoicing & VAT evidence

All — we can do Dec 15 for invoice 1. Ops note: Treasury needs to see expected clearance window; for EU outbound wire we typically see 2 business days. Recommend Maria mark Dec 17 as the earliest cleared date for tranche 1 in your internal checklist.

Also confirming Redwood will set invoice numbers in sequence and push them into the HubSpot billing record (we'll include HubSpot deal id in the remit). I've added a column in the spreadsheet for expected clearance and AR owner.

Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
From: LedgerOps Finance <finance@ledgerops.co>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Maria Santos <maria.santos@procurecorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:36:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — request for staggered invoicing & VAT evidence

Thanks — quick note from LedgerOps (third-party payments team): 

- We received ProcureCorp PO 7421 and confirm the bank coordinates match vendor profile.
- For automated reconciliation, please include the following on each invoice: PO number, Deal ID (DEAL-7421), and the exact remit reference string. Otherwise the payment may require manual routing.
- For VAT evidence: a single zip with country certs is fine, but Treasury also wants the invoice XML attached for Q1 and a checksum/hash for each file.

We will schedule the wire upon receipt of Invoice 1 and the matching XML. Expect a confirmation email once the wire is sent (we'll CC Redwood AP).

LedgerOps Finance Team
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@procurecorp.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T16:40:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — request for staggered invoicing & VAT evidence

Maria — confirming we have updated the invoice tracker and locked the three tranche invoice dates in the billing system per Olga's schedule. Actions completed: 

- Attached: sample invoice XML export for Invoice 1 (attached to this thread in Hub link) and the signed SOW DocuSign link will be sent after you confirm the schedule.
- Added machine-readable VAT block (schema v2) to the invoice template; file checksum: sha256:9f2c...eb3a.
- LedgerOps asked that each invoice have PO 7421 and DEAL-7421 in the remit reference — we will ensure that.

Please review the sample XML here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-invoice-tracker (tab: XML-samples) and confirm we can proceed with Dec 15 invoice issuance. Once you confirm, we'll issue Invoice 1, upload XML to the HubSpot deal, and notify LedgerOps to initiate the wire.

Thanks — Rachel Kim
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Attachments referenced: sample_invoice_7421.xml (linked)
